capabilities: Build and incrementally update a vector index of vault notes
Answer vault questions with citations via hybrid dense/sparse retrieval
Ingest notes into a maintained wiki of source, entity, concept and synthesis pages
Audit the wiki for orphan pages, conflicts, gaps and stale information
Record query logs and evaluation metrics like groundedness and citation accuracy
disambiguation: Not just a chat assistant; it also rewrites your notes into a separate _wiki/ folder of source, entity, concept and synthesis pages.
extras: README is written in Chinese with English command names. Sends note text to the user's configured AI API during indexing, querying and wiki ingestion; auto-indexing and auto-ingest are off by default and it warns about sensitive content like passwords or keys. Data files are stored under .obsidian/plugins/obsidian-ai-rag-plugin/data/.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search is keyword-based and offers no semantic Q&A with citations, nor any automated way to synthesize and maintain accumulated knowledge across notes.

requires.name: User-configured OpenAI-compatible API (base URL, key, chat and embedding models)

summary: AI assistant that answers vault questions via a multi-stage RAG retrieval pipeline and maintains a persistent LLM-curated Markdown wiki built from your notes.
